description: Pay-per-call: 25 free/day then $0.001 USDC via x402. Messy text + JSON Schema in, clean JSON out. Uses a small LLM (Cloudflare Workers AI, Llama 3.1 8B, JSON mode) when available, else a deterministic key:value/regex extractor; the result is type-checked against your schema and missing fields are null. Limits: text <= 6,000 chars, schema <= 30 top-level properties (flat objects, arrays of scalars); the model can misread ambiguous text, so check important values. Params: text, schema (JSON string), mode=auto|heuristic. GET query or POST JSON body. Calling this tool returns the HTTP request and x402 payment requirements (or use the free quota).

schema.description: JSON Schema (type object with properties) as a JSON string

name: extract_json
